Who it’s for

  • Operators and job seekers
  • Founders and investors
  • Brand, design and merchandising teams
  • Fashion and tech journalists and researchers
  • Style-forward shoppers and fashion enthusiasts

Principles

  1. Follow the money. Every company story covers who pays, how much and why.
  2. Try what’s trending. We use the new tools and platforms people are talking about and spotlight the companies behind them.
  3. Explain once, link forever. New concepts get one clear explainer that later stories link to.
  4. Global by default. We look past New York, San Francisco and London to cover fashion tech innovation worldwide, more often and in more depth, including fast-growing markets that aren’t known as fashion hubs but have real success stories.

Stitch in Time

Stitch in Time

A five-part history of fashion tech, one era per part.

Five-part series · Long-form essay

Details
  • Part 1: The lab era, starting with Sabine Seymour: Moondial (founded 1998), her biometric snowboarding base layer (around 2000) and her 2008 book Fashionable Technology
  • Part 2: The 2000s and online luxury
  • Part 3: Instagram and creator commerce
  • Part 4: Digital fashion and the metaverse cycle
  • Part 5: Generative and agentic AI, 2023 to now

Signature: a timeline that adds one era each month.
